name: Bumi humanoid robot
notes: Manufacturer website exposes a Bumi product banner, but event text was not readable. Bangkok exhibition claim and technical specifications remain unverified.

name: Chula Rehabilitation Robots for Stroke Patients
credit: Chulalongkorn University / Robotics and Automation Center
useCase: Stroke rehabilitation exercises for shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle, according to the university project report.
description: Chulalongkorn University reports the CUREs rehabilitation robot system, comprising five robot types for upper- and lower-limb training. This is a project family, not one humanoid model.
notes: Source identifies CUREs and five robot types; do not present all variants as a single humanoid or treat a university report as independent clinical validation.

name: CORGI Healthcare and Physical Therapy Assistant Robot
source: https://www.truedigital.com/en/tdg-story/ทรู-ดิจิทัล-ผนึกกำลัง-รพ
useCase: Treatment and physical-therapy assistance for patients in isolation wards, as reported by True Digital Group.
description: True Digital Group describes CORGI as an isolation-ward medical robot for treatment and physical-therapy assistance, including patient movement and posture analysis. These are developer-reported functions.
notes: The announcement names HAPPY, MELODY, LUCKY and CORGI separately. Images must be checked for the correct robot; no clinical certification is established by this announcement.

name: Dinsaw Mini Home AI Assistance
notes: Indexed university article found, but direct retrieval returns no readable body. Distinguish Home AI Assistance from Mini 3 IPD and Pro4 OPD; no interchangeable model photo selected.

name: Dinsaw Robot

name: Exoskeleton Wheelchair Robot
notes: University article indexed and reviewed: prototype, with ethics approval and patient trials described as future steps in the February 2025 article. Not evidence of deployment readiness. Original photo not retrieved reliably.

name: Kaitomm Robot

notes: Product page explicitly names Kaitomm. Functions are manufacturer claims, not independent research findings.

name: Mirror Telepresence System

name: Mr SAM outpatient service robot

name: NAO
useCase: Education, research and human-robot interaction; source specifications apply to NAO6.
description: NAO is a humanoid platform used for education and research. The current NAO6 product page documents its sensors and programming tools; this generic registry entry does not establish a particular installed hardware version or deployment in Thailand.
notes: Aldebaran reference redirects to Maxtronics. Existing historical manufacturer retained; do not silently relabel historical hardware. NAO6 photograph is version-specific. arXiv:0807.3223 is withdrawn and was not added as verified research.

name: Ninja Robot
notes: Indexed Chula report describes telepresence and vital-sign monitoring. Stage source fails TLS validation. Original article at Nation remains in the database; no generic CU-RoboCOVID image substituted.

name: Pinto Robot
notes: Original page has no readable body on direct retrieval. University and Obodroid reports identify Pinto delivery functions, but no exact-model primary photo was verified in this pass.

name: Radioactive Iodine Therapy Medical Assistant Robot
credit: True Blog / True Digital Group / King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital
useCase: Support for radioactive iodine therapy workflows, including supplies transport and telemedicine, according to the developers.
notes: 2023 developer announcement confirms project and functions; it is not a peer-reviewed trial or certification. Keep descriptive registry name rather than infer a later model name.

name: Robo-Buddy
useCase: Elementary-school coding and computational-thinking activities using RFID command cards.
notes: Project page confirms RFID card programming. It does not identify a journal paper, authors or DOI; no paper relationship invented.
